implementation: workers/shared/pbe-wnba-features.js (the same module builds the training dataset and live vectors)
orientation: Every feature is listed-home-team minus away-team; the model outputs P(listed home team wins).
as_of_rule: A feature reads only FINAL regular-season/postseason team-game rows with a complete box whose game started strictly before as_of AND whose America/New_York calendar date is earlier than the target game date. The target game is never readable. Historical training rows use as_of = scheduled tip - 15 minutes.

params_definition.prior_games: Weight, in games, of the prior-season value when shrinking season-to-date team quality: (n x current + prior_games x carryover x prior) / (n + prior_games).
params_definition.carryover: Fraction of the prior full season (>= 10 games) carried into the new season before shrinkage; 0 prior (league mean) for a franchise without one.

features.name: sos_adj_net
features.def: Shrunk net rating plus mean as-of opponent net rating (strength of schedule), home minus away

features.name: form10
features.def: Last-10 net rating minus shrunk season net rating, home minus away (0 below 3 games)

features.name: home_court
features.def: 1 when the listed home team plays in its own arena, 0 at a neutral site

features.name: rest
features.def: Rest days clamped 0..3 (3 when no current-season game), home minus away

features.name: back_to_back
features.def: Second night of a back-to-back, home minus away

features.name: availability
features.def: Share of last-10 minutes played by players who appeared in the most recent game, home minus away

features.name: continuity
features.def: Share of the last-10 core five (most minutes) who started the most recent game, home minus away

windows.form: last 5 / last 10 current-season finals, 0 below 3 games
windows.rest: ET calendar days between games minus 1, clamped 0..3

candidates_considered.def: Shrunk season-to-date net rating (prior season carryover) home minus away

candidates_considered.name: sos_adj_net
candidates_considered.def: Shrunk net rating plus mean as-of opponent net rating (strength of schedule), home minus away

excluded_inputs: Sportsbook prices, lines and moneylines (market is compared after prediction, never a feature)
Injury reports (ESPN publishes current injuries only, with no timestamped history; availability comes from observed minutes)
Target game final score, box score or play-by-play
Any row from the target game date or later, and any future roster state

eligibility.note: Both teams need at least 3 final games this season before the prediction instant.

no_call.note: Below 53% for the favoured side the model publishes NO CALL (model_near_coin_flip).

confidence.note: Tier from pick probability (Low < 60% <= Medium < 70% <= High); downgraded one tier when either team has fewer than 8 current-season games.

reasoning.method: Contribution = coefficient x standardized feature value (home term: coefficient x home_court flag). impact_pts = 100 x (p - p with that term removed). Oriented to the viewed team by sign.
reasoning.baseline: A standardized feature at 0 means the training-set average game; a factor is relative to that baseline.
reasoning.sign_rule: Contributions from a feature whose coefficient sign differs from expected_sign (0 = no expectation) go to adjustments, not supporting/opposing. Every contribution stays in the prediction record.
